text:
Version 2.4 is out. It fixes 12crashes, so the app should run more smoothly.

App startup is faster, dropping from 3.4 seconds to 1.9 seconds.

This release also adds Offline Mode, so you can keep using the app when you have no connection.

Version 2.4 no longer supports Android 8. Dropping it lets us put more work into new features and performance on newer devices.

Thanks for using the app. Update today to get the changes.
